Hey @vinaykul!
Is this issue still relevant? Is somebody actively working on it?

@tallclair: Reopened this issue.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/109553#issuecomment-2038424782):

>@iholder101 the discussion is still relevant, but I don't know if the design is committed. If you want to propose an addition to the KEP, that's probably the next step.
>
>/reopen
>/remove-lifecycle rotten


Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md).  If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [kubernetes/test-infra](https://github.com/kubernetes/test-infra/issues/new?title=Prow%20issue:) repository.
</details>

> @iholder101 the discussion is still relevant, but I don't know if the design is committed. If you want to propose an addition to the KEP, that's probably the next step.
> 
> /reopen /remove-lifecycle rotten

I see it's already mentioned in the KEP, both under the proposal [[1](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/1287-in-place-update-pod-resources#subresource)] and under the graduation criteria for beta [[2](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/1287-in-place-update-pod-resources#beta)].

If it still has priority and is considered a graduation criteria for Beta, I'd be happy to start working on it. If priority drops or it's no longer relevant, please let me know.

/assign

[1] https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/1287-in-place-update-pod-resources#subresource
[2] https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/1287-in-place-update-pod-resources#beta
@iholder101 This is still relevant, and a fun extension to work on. It is a better way than PATCH verb, and VPA should use it. Please update the KEP as you make progress on it.

I still need to read through the full context for this, but if it's just a matter of having finer grained RBAC control than full pod update permissions, then I wonder if a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy would be sufficient for the VPA case instead of a new subresource. The discussion on https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/3617 is also relevant.

Either way, is this really a beta blocker?

Let me find some time to read through @lavalamp KEP. The reason I marked it as beta blocker is the API becomes official at beta IIRC (we will be committed to supporting PATCH for resize). If that's not the case, then it need not block beta but still is nice to have.
@iholder101 probably best to hold off on this until we agree on the shape of the API in https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/4704

> @iholder101 probably best to hold off on this until we agree on the shape of the API in [kubernetes/enhancements#4704](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/4704)

Thanks for the update! Sure thing.

I'm reassigning this to @AnishShah to unblock progress. @iholder101 please let me know ASAP if you were still hoping to take this.

/assign @AnishShah 
/unassign @iholder101
